Foundation mutations must pass a flat single-row model to their broker.

Back to STXF rulesRead The Standard source

What The Standard says

Foundation mutations must pass a flat single-row model to their broker. The analyser reports this as a warning at the declaration or statement that needs attention.

Why it matters

This rule belongs to the Foundation services family. Following it keeps responsibilities and intent visible to readers, tooling and future maintainers.

Bad code example

// Violates STXF003: Foundation mutations must pass a flat single-row model to their broker.
ValueTask AddStudents(IEnumerable<Student> newStudents) => broker.InsertStudents(newStudents);

Good code example

// Follows STXF003
ValueTask<Student> AddStudent(Student newStudent) => broker.InsertStudent(newStudent);
